titles.english: Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl
titles.native: ポケットモンスター ダイヤモンド&パール

description: After defeating Brandon and declining the offer to be a Frontier Brain, Ash sets off to travel through the far away land of Sinnoh. Once he gets there, he meets up with Hikari, a local trainer from the region, and they decide to travel together.
